'''Rogoe's keep''' was an underwater fortress in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Spearhead/Legends|Spearhead]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was the home of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]] until it and Spearhead were [[Raid on Spearhead|destroyed]] by Boss [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]] and the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]].<ref name="SW:GB" />
